summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of an auto-loan asset-backed securitization. Bridgecrest Acceptance Corporation sold receivables to Bridgecrest Auto Funding LLC, which transferred them to Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2026-3, a newly established Delaware statutory trust. The Issuer entered into a Sale and Servicing Agreement with the trust, seller, servicer, and Computershare Trust Company as indenture trustee and standby servicer. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or strategic event is involved. What to watch: performance of the underlying receivables or note issuance details, but no risk-arb angle exists.
